title: content/glossary.json
description: Glossary terms: the first occurrence of each term in a page gets a tooltip. `pattern` is a regular expression (flags i and u are added); default: the escaped term. `technical` (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.8): where the term lives in the code, shown under the definition in the business and takeover spaces. Legacy files (glossaire.json: terme, motif, def) are normalised before validation.
